expires_today.title: Going Rogue: A Lite Heavy Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Dive into adventure and mystery with this bundle of roguelike and roguelite action games! Make a deal with a demon to exact revenge on your murderer in Brutal Orchestra! Survive a decaying spaceship full of killer monsters in the procedurally generated deep space purgatory of Moros Protocol! Take on the adventures and challenges of these roguelikes and more in this bundle, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase at the price of your choice!

Keys expire. Please redeem Moros Protocol before January 15th, 2027 and remaining titles before July 15th, 2027.

expires_today.title: And the Winner Is: Award Winning Fantasy, Science Fiction, & Horror from Tachyon
expires_today.long_description: Here at Humble, we only want to give you the best of the best, and for our more discerning readers we’ve crafted a bundle of sci-fi, fantasy, and horror ebooks from Tachyon that aren’t just great reads, but award-winning modern classics! Dive into tales of technology and terror from genre-blending master Peter Watts in his short story collection Beyond the Rift! Wartime history and B-movie schlock combine in James Morrow’s World War II kaiju extravaganza Shambling Towards Hiroshima! An utterly unique voice takes on worlds beyond our own in Ellen Klages’ haunting short story collection Portable Childhoods! There is so much more to discover in this collection of fiction from some of today’s most daring authors, so grab these books while you can at the price of your choice, and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Upload VR Summer 2026
expires_today.long_description:
Freshen up your VR collection with an epic bundle of titles perfect for any platform. Jump into the cockpit of a wide variety of aircraft in VTOL VR, a near-futuristic combat flight game built to get your heart pumping! Brave Metro Awakening, a story-driven VR adventure that blends exploration and FPS gameplay to deliver a completely immersive experience. Or get a lil’ strange with Among Us 3D, a new twist on the original game’s formula that drops you into chaos! Step out of reality and into a world of savings—plus, your purchase helps support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 8th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Unreal Environment Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Craft beautiful vistas in a fraction of the time it normally takes your team with the all-new Unreal Environment Bundle. Set the scene for epic boss battles, cozy sims, and more with crisp, easy-to-use preset Environmental Packs like Coast & Dunes, Mountain, Forest, Meadow, and more. Add layers of detailed depth to any scenery or scenario with asset sets that mesh seamlessly with each other. Unlock everything you need from the ground up with these elite environmental tools from NatureManufacture, and help support the Starlight Children's Foundation with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow and More! by DC Comics
expires_within_72h.description: It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s Supergirl!
expires_within_72h.long_description:
If you’ve found yourself in serious need of comics after seeing DC’s superhero smash Supergirl, or if you want to give yourself a crash course before buying tickets, we’ve got a Supergirl comic bundle just for you! Collected here are the Girl of Steel’s most iconic adventures and essential arcs including all five volumes of Jeph Loeb’s beloved run, all six volumes of Supergirl’s New 52 rebrand, and all four books of Peter David’s delightfully surprising riff on the character. And it looks like a few issues starring a certain alien bounty hunter and a superpowered canine snuck in here too! Whether you’re a new fan or an old friend of the Girl of Tomorrow, grab these comic collections at the price of your choice, and support the real heroes at the Book Industry Charitable Foundation with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through neonichiban.com. To access the content, create or log in to your neonichiban.com account.

expires_within_72h.title: Arc System Works: Evo Collection
expires_within_72h.description: Play Fighting Games. Fight for Something Bigger.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
What’s better than getting a collection of fighting games from Arc System Works in celebration of Evo 2026? Supporting the fight against rare disease while you’re at it. Throw hands in style with big-time fighting games that dominate the competitive scene. Dive into an epic bundle of Guilty Gear titles highlighted by the dynamic 2D x 3D hybrid Guilty Gear -STRIVE-, alongside all five available Season Passes. Or challenge your skills in competitive staples like BlazBlue: Central Fiction and Under Night In-Birth II. Your bundle purchase supports the Raiden Science Foundation and its Fight4Rare initiative, helping ignite hope and advance rare disease treatment and research.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 17th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Sonic 35th Anniversary Megabundle by IDW
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Celebrate 35 years of Sonic the Hedgehog with this megabundle of Sonic comics from IDW! What kinds of mischief have Sonic, his pals, and Dr. Eggman gotten into outside of the video games? Now you can find out! Catch the Blue Blur speeding through the pages of the official Sonic the Hedgehog comic series, collected together in 21 volumes of adventure and fun! Stay up to speed on all the Sonic mini-series like Imposter Syndrome, Tangle & Whisper, and Fang the Hunter! Enjoy all your favorite stories plus all the bonus content featured in Sonic’s 30th Anniversary Deluxe Edition! This bundle is perfect for diehard Sonic fans and newcomers alike, so snag it at the price of your choosing before it speeds away, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before July 11, 2027.
